text.en:
NEGARA BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE No. S 12

LAW REVISION ACT (20 of 1983) LAW REVISION (OMITTED LAWS) ORDER 1985 In exercise of his powers under section 12(1) of the Law Revision Act His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan hereby makes the following Order - Citation. 1. This Order may be cited as the Law Revision (Omitted Laws) Order 1985. Omission of 2. The Acts in the Schedule to this Order are hereby omitted from certain Laws. the Laws of Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN
